recorded_uses.name: Warfarin
recorded_uses.pros: Proven to cut stroke risk in atrial fibrillation; dose can be guided by a blood test.
recorded_uses.cons: Needs regular monitoring; interacts with many foods and medicines; bleeding risk.
recorded_uses.cautions: Carries a bleeding warning; stopping it suddenly raises clot and stroke risk.
recorded_uses.uses: Lowering the risk of clots and stroke caused by an irregular heartbeat.

recorded_uses.name: Warfarin
recorded_uses.pros: Decades of outcome evidence; effect can be measured and adjusted by a blood test.
recorded_uses.cons: Needs regular blood tests; many food and medicine interactions; bleeding risk.
recorded_uses.cautions: Carries a bleeding warning; not used in pregnancy except for mechanical heart valves.
recorded_uses.uses: Treating and preventing clots in the veins and in the lungs.
common_side_effects: rarely tissue damage from skin blood-vessel clots
recorded_uses.condition_name: Blood clot in a vein (DVT or pulmonary embolism)

recorded_uses.name: Warfarin
recorded_uses.pros: Label-supported for reducing repeat heart attack and clot-related events.
recorded_uses.cons: Bleeding risk and frequent monitoring make it harder to use than antiplatelet tablets.
recorded_uses.cautions: Carries a bleeding warning; never start or stop it without the treating doctor.
recorded_uses.uses: Lowering the risk of death and of a further heart attack after one has happened.
recorded_uses.condition_name: Prevention of a further heart attack or stroke
